members_inferred_from_repo: Wolverines and r1ver once they hold a laser
laser_standoff_farmer.signature: laser in weapon list by 4-15 s (worst case 60 s); charging flag cycles about every 2.4 s; speed at or below walk; keeps 150-250 m from others; cube count 6+ by 100 s and 15-35 late
laser_standoff_farmer.counter_rule: If a visible mech is charging and its aim yaw is within 0.25 rad of the bearing to us, sidestep at boost to the nearest building edge; never stop in open sight of a laser carrier; fight it only from a corner, inside 40 m with lightning (2 s laser short), or as a third party when it is below half HP. When we fire a laser at one, charge with the aim 0.3 rad off the target, then swing on and release within one decision (the public bots dodge only while the aim is on them).
laser_standoff_farmer.risk_if_wrong: Low: over-avoiding a harmless mech costs farming time only.

members_inferred_from_repo: Wolverines and r1ver whenever they hold lightning
lightning_closer.signature: lightning in weapon list and range to us shrinking below 60 m; max_hp well above 1400 early (hull upgrades); late first pickup (about 60 s)
lightning_closer.counter_rule: Hold more than 50 m (60 m if its max_hp shows many upgrades) and back along cover while firing laser or gun; never let a lightning carrier inside 45 m unless we also hold lightning and more HP.
lightning_closer.risk_if_wrong: Medium: backing away can push us into a third mech or the zone edge; check the retreat lane first.

members_inferred_from_repo: Kanyaraasi and BackwardsDeployeds before they hold a laser
sight_triggered_brawler.signature: torso turns to us and gun fire starts as soon as we are mutually visible, at any range to 230 m; strafes sideways with direction flips (every 0.35-1.05 s in one public family, 1.0-2.6 s in the other); settles near 70-85 m with gun, 110 m with laser, 28 m with lightning; walks to cubes mid-fight
sight_triggered_brawler.counter_rule: Do not trade in the open: break line of sight for 5 s (target memory is 4 s in one family) and it returns to looting; punish from a corner when it walks to a cube or when another mech engages it; it runs to cover below 35-38% HP.
sight_triggered_brawler.risk_if_wrong: Low: if it is actually a free-for-all-aware build it will not shoot first and nothing is lost.

boost_rusher.signature: ground speed near 19.5 m/s for a third or more of the time, closing on a mech, gun only during the first 30 s
boost_rusher.counter_rule: Stay behind a corner facing its approach and burst it on arrival (it arrives with little energy); never flee across open ground; collect its cubes only if nobody else is within 150 m.
boost_rusher.risk_if_wrong: High if it carries lightning (240 damage/s inside 45 m): read the weapon list first and keep 50 m if lightning is shown.

quiet_hider.signature: stationary or under 5 m/s behind a building at 0.5-0.6 of the next circle radius; holds fire; fewer than 10 cubes at 3 minutes
quiet_hider.counter_rule: Leave it alone and out-farm it; pass at more than 55 m with torso facing it, HP above 55% and no laser charging (the public restraint rules trigger inside 35-55 m, on targets under 45-55% HP, on chargers and on turned backs); kill it when the circle forces it to move and we lead by 10+ cubes.
quiet_hider.risk_if_wrong: Medium: a motionless mech may be a laser carrier waiting; the charging rule above covers that case.

AT.loadout: laser + lightning (both wins); laser 84-85% of damage
habits: takes a laser fast when one is near (4 s) but still won with a 63 s laser
fires almost all the time (not firing only 3% and 13% of the match): shoots drones, crates and far targets
stays 159-176 m from the nearest mech, boosts 9-11% of the time, never holds still in the open
54-57% of its hits land on mechs already below half HP; 43% of hits were third-party in one win
farms hard: 24 and 35 cubes, 2 and 4 drones, no supply drops; both wins were over in 141-149 s
boom or bust: 2 wins but about 9th on average over up to 11 showdowns
limitations: constant firing gives its position away (laser shot carries 380 m, gun 320 m)
its laser is telegraphed by the charging flag and blocked by buildings
early deaths are common when the opening goes wrong (mean about 9th despite two wins)
no supply drops taken, so a drop holder can out-heal it
AT.signature: laser (+lightning) carrier firing continuously from 150+ m, low speed, cube count climbing fast (10-15 per minute in its wins)
AT.counter: Use its noise to keep a building between us; apply the charging-laser rule; in the first 90 s do nothing that draws its fire; late, close through cover to under 40 m with lightning or leave it to others.
AT.risk_if_read_wrong: If it is a newer, quieter build the noise cue disappears; the charging rule still applies.
AT.version_staleness: Recorded wins are from the 02:00 and 03:00 UTC showdowns; its best entry is from 03:43 UTC, so today's bot is newer.

habits: about 4.2th on average with 17 cubes; such bots fill empty seats in the final

counter_rules: Opening: for the first 90 s start no fight, keep every mech beyond 60 m (aim for 150 m), boost only to break sight.
Charging laser: charging flag plus aim within 0.25 rad of our bearing means sidestep at boost to a building edge; inside 40 m with lightning, zap instead.
Economy: farm only with the nearest known mech beyond 150 m; pace about 7 cubes a minute (6 by 60 s, 15 by 150 s, 25 by 250 s); take a drop only uncontested.
Wounded rule: never be visible below 55% HP; shoot first only at targets below 50% HP that someone else is already fighting.
Read the weapon list: lightning closing means keep 50 m; gun-only booster means corner ambush; shoot-on-sight means break sight for 5 s; motionless quiet mech means pass beyond 55 m facing it.
Our own laser: charge with the aim 0.3 rad off the target, swing on and release inside one decision; public bots dodge only while a charging aim points at them.
